KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. nene
   C. fupi
   D. pana

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

3. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

6. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

7. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. mitoto
   C. kitoto
   D. watoto

8. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.

9. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
